text: Two things helped save her. First, the broken cables piled up at the bottom of the shaft, coiling under the car like a giant spring. Second, the shaft was tight around the car. The air underneath had nowhere to go, so it was squeezed into a cushion that slowed the fall. She was badly injured, but she lived. It's still the longest elevator fall anyone is known to have survived. Five months later, she rode an elevator to the top of the Empire State Building again.
